app.title: Show HN: Raven – The harness of harnesses, built for RSI
app.author: cyfyifanchen
app.description: Raven is a modular harness framework designed to streamline the development of RSI (Robotic Systems Integration) applications, providing reusable components and orchestration utilities.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run 'npm install' (or equivalent) to ensure dependencies resolve.
Execute the provided example harness script and verify it outputs the expected integration flow.
Run 'npm test' or the built-in test suite to confirm all unit tests pass.
Measure startup latency of the harness when loading a complex component graph.
